text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but gains relative to my purchase price alone are not a reason to sell; I should judge each position by its future prospects and portfolio role.","I tend to avoid realizing losses, but refusing to sell just to avoid regret can keep me invested for the wrong reason. I should reassess holdings consistently, whether they are up or down.","My account value moved little after the early rise, and past price changes do not predict what comes next. I should avoid overreacting to short-term moves and make deliberate, diversified decisions."]}
